نتدافق (form VI)
# نَتَدَافَقُ (natadāfaqu) /na.ta.daː.fa.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَدَافَقَ (tadāfaqa)
# نَتَدَافَقَ (natadāfaqa) /na.ta.daː.fa.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَدَافَقَ (tadāfaqa)
# نَتَدَافَقْ (natadāfaq) /na.ta.daː.faq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَدَافَقَ (tadāfaqa)
